posts.text: Namaste! 🙏 Customer white shirt maange aur aapke paas L size khatam? Menswear basics hi roz ka steady business laate hain. Our new free guide lists the shirts, trousers, jeans and tees every small-town shop should carry, the sizes that sell most, and how to reorder without overbuying:

Menswear basics = steady cash for your shop. 👔

Our new guide for clothing shop owners covers:
• The core list: shirts, trousers, jeans, tees, innerwear
• Sizes and colours that rarely become dead stock
• What to add for festive, wedding and winter seasons
• Starting small and reordering what sells
• Display tips that make men buy the whole look

Read it free at the link in bio.

#Menswear #ClothingShop #RetailIndia #WholesaleClothing #ShopOwner #SmallBusinessIndia #GarmentBazaar

For many small-town clothing shops, menswear basics are the quiet backbone of the business.

A customer who comes in for a white shirt or a pair of dark jeans usually knows exactly what he wants, buys quickly and returns for the same thing. The common mistakes are predictable: running out of M, L and XL while odd sizes pile up, and putting too much money into trend colours the town is not asking for.

We wrote a practical guide for retailers on which menswear basics to carry, how to split the budget between safe and trend pieces, what to add each season, and why fast reordering beats one big buy.

On GarmentBazaar, retailers can browse branded wholesale menswear with the price per piece shown up front and brand-set MOQs, then reorder from their dashboard. Free to join.
